description: Header file defining classes and functions for CRC memory copy operations, including architecture-specific optimizations and fallback implementations.

classes.name: CrcMemcpyEngine
classes.description: Abstract base class for CRC memcpy engines with a virtual compute method.

classes.name: CrcMemcpy
classes.description: Provides static methods for CRC-based memory copying, including architecture-specific engine selection.

classes.name: FallbackCrcMemcpyEngine
classes.description: Fallback implementation of CRC memcpy engine.

classes.name: CrcNonTemporalMemcpyEngine
classes.description: CRC memcpy engine using non-temporal instructions.

classes.name: CrcNonTemporalMemcpyAVXEngine
classes.description: CRC memcpy engine using AVX instructions for non-temporal memory copy.

methods.name: CrcAndCopy
methods.description: Performs CRC-based memory copy using architecture-specific engine.

methods.name: GetTestEngine
methods.description: Returns an architecture-specific CRC memcpy engine for testing purposes.

methods.name: Compute
methods.description: Computes CRC32C checksum while copying memory, implemented in derived classes.
